messages:
Marcus (partnerships): Quick sync  AWS Marketplace combined webinar + live SI integration demo with CloudBridge and SuperChip hardware on Nov 7. Goal: marketplace listing, live pipeline demo, and a post-webinar how-to. Need owners for marketplace assets, demo env, and swag. Thoughts?

Vikram (AWS): AWS can co-promote if marketplace listing & 1-page datasheet approved 3 weeks out. Marketplace artwork deadline = Oct 10. Also need a test listing account.

Karen (CloudBridge): CloudBridge can present a short integration run-through (5-7 mins) showing how they onboard a customer into our API + infra. We can bring a real customer success story.

Elena (solutions): I'll coordinate the SI playbook and customer invite. We should script the data flow: customer upload -> SI pipeline -> Redwood endpoint.

Tomas (eng): I'll build a reproducible demo harness. My plan: host model on Dedicated for throughput, and have SuperChip box as network-isolated fallback. Will need docker image and a small dataset.

Nina (marketing): Swag idea: co-branded microfiber laptop sleeves, 300 postcards with 1-click QR to marketplace listing, and 400 stickers. Ship to staging warehouse for quality check.

Marcus (partnerships): Logistics Qs: who arranges SuperChip hardware onsite? Is CloudBridge bringing a laptop? We should set a 4-hour dry run on Nov 6.

Karen (CloudBridge): We can bring a laptop and a small Intel/NVIDIA inference node. SuperChip to confirm their crate/ship windows. We'll need an HDMI passthrough for the demo machine.

Tomas (eng): Demo sketch:
```
# demo script
1. start local mock of customer upload: python demo/upload_customer.py --file sample_data.json
2. trigger SI pipeline: curl -X POST https://si.cloudbridge.io/pipeline/start -d '{"customer":"acme"}'
3. call Redwood: POST /v1/responses with streaming on
```
I'll containerize all of it.

Vikram (AWS): Marketplace checklist: datasheet, logos (EPS), short description (<= 500 chars), pricing template. Deadline Oct 10. I can share the marketplace template.

Nina (marketing): I'll draft the webinar landing page, coordinate email blasts, and build the QR postcard artwork. Need logo EPS from partners by Sept 30.

Marcus (partnerships): AV & recording: ops-bot, please create a recording reservation and set a backup record to our S3.

ops-bot: Done  Created "Nov7_Redwood_AWS_CloudBridge_Webinar" recording job. Bucket: s3://redwood-recordings/nov7.

Elena (solutions): Bring checklist for runbook: endpoints, sample creds, rollback steps if live call fails. We should have a pre-recorded short demo (3-4 min) as backup.

Tomas (eng): Agreed. I'll produce a 3-min canned demo video and a health-check script. Health-check example: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health || (play video)

Nina (marketing): Budget approval needed for swag by Sept 15. I'll submit PO and vendor quote once partners approve artwork.

Marcus (partnerships): Proposed action owners + due dates:
- Marcus: finalize partner runbook + calendar invites (due Aug 28)
- Tomas: demo harness + canned video (due Oct 15)
- Elena: SI playbook + customer brief (due Sep 30)
- Nina: marketing assets + swag PO (due Sep 15)
- Vikram: marketplace template & test account (due Oct 1)
- Karen: customer confirmation & on-site gear list (due Oct 10)

Karen (CloudBridge): We'll confirm customer speaker by Sept 20. Prefer a 5-min recorded clip if they can't present live.

Vikram (AWS): I'll line up a Marketplace listing reviewer to speed approvals. Ping me if you need introductions.

Nina (marketing): Also thinking about a small follow-up: a how-to doc + GitHub repo with the demo harness. That will help post-webinar conversions.

Tomas (eng): Will open a public repo with demo code and a small README. I'll include docker-compose for local fallback.

Marcus (partnerships): Excellent. If no objections, I'll lock the Nov 7 date and start the runbook. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you can hit your commitments.

Elena (solutions): :white_check_mark:

Tomas (eng): :white_check_mark:

Nina (marketing): :white_check_mark:

Vikram (AWS): :white_check_mark:

Karen (CloudBridge): :white_check_mark:
